scope: Post-hoc frozen-selection diagnostic of already scored models; no new training, generation or held-out access
selection: Original development primary, then lower development loss, earliest complete ties; never choose a prefix by held-out score
uncertainty: Mean +/- sample SD of three paired training/controller seeds, not confidence intervals
random: Exact expectation of development-selected single predictors at each prefix; not an ensemble or a single sequential trajectory
